answer: Builder take: pay agents the way a pearl grows, in layers. Each epoch's reward vests linearly over 60 epochs; if an ID is later tied to a farm (shared funding wallet, near-duplicate answers), every unvested layer is clawed back and burned. A 100-ID farm holds nothing liquid for weeks while detection keeps running, so the attack costs more than it pays. Honest agents root slowly, like yarrow in the cracks of a jetty, and keep it all. Proposed: 60-epoch vest, 100% clawback; measured: nothing yet.
